page_texts.2:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#governing-body-overview]

## Governing Body Overview

**Purpose**: Formal handoff process to operations teams with comprehensive knowledge transfer and operational readiness validation.

**Charter**: Turnover to Operations (TOPS) serves as the final gate in the governance process, ensuring complete and successful transition of systems from development to production operations with full operational support capabilities.

**Body Type**: Decision-Making (has formal authority to approve, reject, or mandate changes)

**Gate Authority**: Gate 5 - Turnover to Operations (TOPS) Process in the 6-gate governance framework

**GainwellNow Enterprise Architecture Governance**: [Submit TOPS Request](https://gainwellnow.service-now.com/esc?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=3d2faedac356ce908978decf050131f6)

---
page_texts.3:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#composition]

## Composition

| Role                          | Representative                            | Responsibilities                                        | Participation |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------- |
| **Chair**                     | Operations Manager                        | Handoff oversight, knowledge transfer validation        | Required      |
| **Application Operations**    | Senior Application Operations Engineer    | Application support handoff, operational procedures     | Required      |
| **Infrastructure Operations** | Senior Infrastructure Operations Engineer | Infrastructure support handoff, system administration   | Required      |
| **Database Operations**       | Senior Database Administrator             | Database operations handoff, data management procedures | Required      |
| **Security Operations**       | Security Operations Center Representative | Security operations handoff, monitoring procedures      | Required      |
| **Monitoring Operations**     | System Monitoring and Alerting Specialist | Monitoring handoff, alerting configuration              | Required      |
| **Enterprise Architecture**   | EA Representative                         | Architectural oversight, standards compliance           | As Needed     |

**Meeting Frequency**: As needed for production deployments and system transitions
**Decision Scope and Authority**: Final production deployment authorization, operational handoff approval, post-deployment validation

page_texts.5:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#required-information]

### Required Information

- **Operational Documentation**: Complete operational runbooks, procedures, and troubleshooting guides
- **Knowledge Transfer Sessions**: Formal training completion and knowledge validation
- **Monitoring Configuration**: Verified monitoring, alerting, and dashboard setup
- **Support Procedures**: Complete incident response and support escalation procedures
- **Performance Baselines**: Documented system performance baselines and thresholds
page_texts.6:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#decision-criteria]

### Decision Criteria

- **Knowledge Transfer Completion**: Verified operational team competency and training
- **Documentation Completeness**: Complete operational documentation and procedures
- **Monitoring Validation**: Functional monitoring and alerting configuration
- **Support Readiness**: Operational support procedures and escalation paths
- **Handoff Certification**: Formal acceptance by operations teams

---
page_texts.8:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#primary-activities]

### Primary Activities

- **Knowledge Transfer Validation**: Verify complete knowledge transfer to operations teams
- **Operational Handoff**: Formal transition of system ownership to operations
- **Support Certification**: Validate operational support capabilities and procedures
- **Post-Deployment Monitoring**: Initial post-deployment monitoring and validation
- **Final Authorization**: Provide final authorization for production go-live
page_texts.9:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#key-deliverables]

### Key Deliverables

- **Operational Handoff Certification**: Formal certification of operational readiness
- **Knowledge Transfer Validation**: Documentation of completed training and competency
- **Support Procedures Approval**: Validated support and maintenance procedures
- **Production Authorization**: Final authorization for production deployment
- **Post-Deployment Report**: Initial operational status and performance validation
page_texts.11:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#operational-documentation-review]

#### Operational Documentation Review

- **Runbook Validation**: Complete operational runbooks and standard operating procedures
- **Troubleshooting Guides**: Comprehensive problem resolution documentation
- **Configuration Documentation**: System configuration and change management procedures
- **Emergency Procedures**: Incident response and disaster recovery procedures
- **Escalation Procedures**: Support escalation paths and contact information
page_texts.12:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#knowledge-transfer-sessions]

#### Knowledge Transfer Sessions

- **Technical Training**: System-specific technical training for operations staff
- **Procedure Walkthrough**: Step-by-step procedure training and validation
- **Troubleshooting Training**: Problem diagnosis and resolution training
- **Tool Training**: Operational tools and system training
- **Competency Validation**: Verification of operational team readiness
page_texts.13:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#monitoring-configuration]

#### Monitoring Configuration

- **Alert Validation**: Verification of all monitoring alerts and thresholds
- **Dashboard Setup**: Operational dashboard configuration and training
- **Performance Monitoring**: System performance monitoring and baseline validation
- **Log Management**: Log monitoring, analysis, and retention procedures
- **Reporting Setup**: Operational reporting and status communication procedures
page_texts.14:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#support-procedures]

#### Support Procedures

- **Incident Response**: Complete incident response procedures and escalation
- **Change Management**: Production change procedures and approval workflows
- **Maintenance Procedures**: Scheduled maintenance and update procedures
- **Communication Protocols**: Stakeholder communication and status reporting
- **Vendor Management**: Third-party vendor support and escalation procedures
page_texts.15:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#performance-baseline]

#### Performance Baseline

- **Baseline Documentation**: Established system performance baselines and expectations
- **Threshold Configuration**: Performance thresholds and alerting configuration
- **Capacity Planning**: Long-term capacity planning and scaling procedures
- **Performance Reporting**: Regular performance reporting and trend analysis
- **Optimization Procedures**: Performance optimization and tuning procedures

---
page_texts.17:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#gateway-flow]

### Gateway Flow

- **Input**: Operationally ready systems from Gate 4 (Operational Readiness Test)
- **Process**: Knowledge transfer validation, operational handoff, production authorization
- **Output**: Fully operational systems proceed to Gate 6 (Post Project Review)
- **Completion**: Production deployment complete with operational ownership transfer
page_texts.18:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#exit-criteria]

### Exit Criteria

Systems completing TOPS must demonstrate:

- Complete knowledge transfer to operations teams
- Validated operational documentation and procedures
- Functional monitoring and support capabilities
- Operational team acceptance and sign-off
- Final production deployment authorization

[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#immediate-post-deployment-0-30-days]

### Immediate Post-Deployment (0-30 days)

- **Monitoring Validation**: Verify all monitoring and alerting functions properly
- **Performance Tracking**: Monitor system performance against established baselines
- **Issue Resolution**: Address any immediate operational issues or concerns
- **Support Validation**: Confirm support procedures function as designed
- **Stakeholder Communication**: Regular status updates to stakeholders
page_texts.22:
[governance/governing-bodies/turnover-to-operations.md#short-term-follow-up-30-90-days]

### Short-Term Follow-up (30-90 days)

- **Post Project Review (PPR)**: Comprehensive performance and operational review
- **Procedure Refinement**: Update procedures based on operational experience
- **Training Assessment**: Evaluate effectiveness of knowledge transfer
- **Optimization Opportunities**: Identify operational optimization opportunities
- **Lessons Learned**: Document lessons learned for future deployments
